prompt:
You receive 2 images. Image 1 is a finished background painting of our point-and-click adventure game: the paved forecourt of Hotel Grand Jasna at Jasna, view to Chopok, painted in summer 2035. Image 2 is the same painting with coloured boxes that only mark the interactive objects, the exits and the walkable floor, which must all stay exactly where they are. Edit image 1 into the SAME PLACE on 6 February 2035, a clear cold day in deep winter, seen by the SAME CAMERA: keep the exact viewpoint, lens, horizon, perspective and framing, and keep the position, size and outline of every building, wall, door, window, pole, rail, sign, piece of furniture, object and tree trunk. Change only what winter changes, as described below. Keep the painting technique, brushwork, palette handling and level of detail of image 1.

Winter changes:
- Deep fresh snow (40-60 cm) lies on every roof: thick rounded snow caps on the mansard roofs, the big gable, the
  canopy over the main entrance, the small canopy over the side door and the flat roof of the glass gondola station at
  the left; a row of long icicles hangs from the eaves and from the wooden balcony rails. The windows stay the same.
- The big old spruce (the box labelled 'Tieň stromu' in image 2 (x 300-560, y 470-740 of the 1920x1080 frame (16-29 % from the left, 44-69 % from the top))) keeps exactly its shape, size and trunk, but every branch layer carries a
  load of snow; its long blue shadow still falls across the paved forecourt (keep the shadow clearly visible).
- The shrubs behind the stone walls are white snow mounds; the stone walls wear a thick snow cap; the meadow behind is
  deep, smooth snow. The gravel footpath through the gap in the wall (the box labelled 'exit: Chodník pri Vrbickom plese' in image 2 (x 650-760, y 560-652 of the 1920x1080 frame (34-40 % from the left, 52-60 % from the top))) is a trodden snow path between
  low snow banks; the wooden trail post beside it stays dark and clear. The paved side path past the gondola station
  (the box labelled 'exit: Klientske centrum Biela Púť' in image 2 (x 130-260, y 560-652 of the 1920x1080 frame (7-14 % from the left, 52-60 % from the top))) is cleared, with snow banks on both sides.
- The dark spruce forest is dusted and loaded with snow. Chopok and its ridges are deep white winter mountains with
  rocky outcrops showing through; on the slopes far away, groomed ski pistes (smooth white bands between the forest
  edges) with a few tiny distant skiers; the summit buildings white with snow.
- The gondola ropes at the top left carry two or three small closed gondola cabins (no logos).
- The stone fountain is frozen: no running water, a cap of snow and small icicles on the spout.
- The brass luggage trolley (the box labelled 'Batožinový vozík' in image 2 (x 1440-1580, y 462-724 of the 1920x1080 frame (75-82 % from the left, 43-67 % from the top))) stays fully visible and the same, with its suitcases and a thin line
  of snow on its top rail. The roll-up banner with the turquoise circle and the small leaflet table stay unchanged
  (a little snow on the table edge).
- The lettering on the gable stays exactly as painted in image 1.
- Sky: clear, deep winter blue with one small cloud; low sun from the upper left; sparkle on the snow.

Walkable floor: the band at x 0-1920, y 652-1015 of the 1920x1080 frame (0-100 % from the left, 60-94 % from the top) is the cleared paved forecourt: the same grey paving stones, cold and slightly wet-dark, with
a thin dusting of snow and a few faint footprints - ONE continuous flat surface. The snow cleared from it lies in low
snow banks ONLY along the foot of the stone walls, the hotel wall and the edges outside this area, never inside it.
NPC zone at x 843-958, y 535-772 of the 1920x1080 frame (44-50 % from the left, 50-71 % from the top): an animated character sprite will be drawn here later, so paint no person, figure or silhouette in it. The character's feet stand on the floor at y 770.

Fiction rules: no new lettering, no logos, no people except a few tiny distant skiers on the far slopes, no animals,
no cars.

Image 2 is a positioning aid only: do NOT draw any of its boxes, outlines, labels or captions. The result is image 1 edited, in the same 16:9 framing: no frames, no borders, no UI, no captions, no watermark, no text except the lettering already in image 1, and no people or animals unless stated above.

Lighting: a clear, cold, sunny winter day in the Low Tatras mountains: deep clean blue sky, low winter sun, crisp blue-violet shadows on the snow, sparkle on fresh snow, cold bright air. The brushwork, line quality and palette harmony stay exactly those of image 1 (style A).

Style: classic 1990s hand-painted adventure game background. Rich painterly brushwork, slightly exaggerated cartoon proportions with gently curved lines, warm late-afternoon sunlight, saturated but harmonious colours, soft dappled shadows under the trees.
